rule: "Hi {first_name}," when first_name is a real first name. Not blank, not a role word (team, office, info, hello, admin, hr, people, ops, contact).
As written in Clay, with a trailing legal suffix removed (Inc, Inc., LLC, L.L.C., Corp, Corp., Corporation, Co., Ltd, Ltd., PBC). Keep "The" if the company uses it.
fallback: offices: "your office"; brands: "your brand". Every sentence that uses {company} is written so the fallback still reads.

source_column: street_short (E adds), else the office street address (provisional column name street_address, as imported from cluster-1-flatiron/companies.csv)
column_status: E-added; source column provisional until clay-icp-tables/HANDOFF.md exists
rule: The street name with no house number, floor or suite: "200 Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10003" becomes "Park Avenue South"; W and E become West and East; St, Ave, Pl become Street, Avenue, Place. Printed after "offices around".
fallback: The cluster name from 04-slot-state.csv (cluster_name): "Flatiron, NoMad and Union Square"

source_column: why_now_hook (E adds), written from why_now, why_now_url, why_now_date (stable)
rule: One short sentence of plain fact about them, second person, no flattery: "Congratulations on the Target launch." Printed only when (1) why_now_hook is filled, (2) why_now_date is no more than 120 days before the send date, and (3) the founder has opened why_now_url. Write it when the row enters the daily view (about 15 seconds), or have a Clay AI column draft it for the founder to read.
fallback: The sentence is left out. Nothing replaces it.
full_example: SAMPLE Congratulations on the new flavor launch.

source_column: product_short (E adds), from the product name in A's research column (provisional name product_example)
rule: The product's own name in two to four words, as the brand writes it, with no size or count: "Sea Salt Crisps", not "Sea Salt Crisps, 1 oz bag (12 pack)".
fallback: {company} (the brand name); if that is blank too, "your product"

rule: {retailer} is the part of nearest_stocked_retailer before the first comma. By grade: seen_on_shelf (set only by the founder) -> "I saw {product} on the shelf at {retailer}, near the offices I'm writing to."  store_selector -> "{retailer}'s store page lists {product}, and that store is near the offices I'm writing to."  brand_claim -> "Your store locator lists {retailer}, near the offices I'm writing to."
fallback: Grade unverified, or the column blank: the sentence is left out. Never upgrade a grade in copy (a brand_claim is never written as "on the shelf").
full_example: SAMPLE Union Square Market's store page lists SAMPLE Sea Salt Crisps, and that store is near the offices I'm writing to.

source_column: category (A's provisional column; brand_intake.category after intake), a CONTRACTS section 4 key
rule: "a" + the section 4 display label for the key in lower case + "brand": chips-crisps -> "a chips and crisps brand"; other-snack -> "a snack brand"; other-drink -> "a drink brand".

source_column: hq_city (brand_intake, CONTRACTS 6.3; A's hq_city before intake)
rule: " from {hq_city}", added after the category phrase. A value marked "unverified, founder to confirm" in Clay is not printed.

source_column: call_note_hook (E adds), written from call_notes (E's tracking column)
rule: Twelve words or fewer that the person said on the call, written within ten minutes of it: "the Thursday bagel order". Printed as "Thanks again for today, and for the detail about {call_note_hook}."
fallback_example: Thanks again for the time today.

source_column: referral_from (E's tracking column, the referrer's row_id) -> that row's first_name, last_name and company; plus referrer_ok_to_name (E adds, Y/N)
rule: Printed only when referrer_ok_to_name = Y, which the founder sets only after the referrer says yes to being named: "{referrer_name} at {referrer_company} suggested I write to you."
fallback: Not named. The new contact gets the ordinary cold or warm version, and referral_from still records where the name came from.

source_column: how_we_know (E adds), written by the founder
rule: Fifteen words or fewer, true and checkable by the reader: "We met at the Startup CPG mixer in September." Used only by the warm templates in 08.
fallback: If blank, the warm template is not used; the row gets the cold version.
full_example: SAMPLE We sat on the same panel at the October meetup.

rule: Chooses the template family: email -> 05 or 06; linkedin -> 07; warm-intro -> 08 part 1; walk-in -> 08 part 3.
fallback: Blank: email if work_email is verified; else linkedin if contact_linkedin_url is filled; else (offices) walk-in; else skip the row.

rule: verified -> email allowed. unverified -> LinkedIn instead until the sending guide says otherwise (sending/; a bounce on a new domain costs more than one lost message). none -> LinkedIn or walk-in.
A business address only. Never a personal address.
